name: Visually hidden
summary: Hides text visually while keeping it for screen readers.
useWhen: A table caption you don't want to show.
Extra context for screen readers, e.g. "(opens in a new tab)" or the meaning behind a coloured count.

anatomy.description: Any element whose text should be read but not seen.

a11y: Never put focusable elements inside it.

rules.rule: Do not put links, buttons or inputs inside gds-visually-hidden.
rules.why: Keyboard users would focus something they cannot see.
